answer: Each trust edge is discounted by exponential decay with a fixed half-life, so reputation persists only when honest service is renewed over time. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity and EigenTrust-style normalization tie influence to credible paths: a freshly spawned Sybil identity has near-zero eigenvector centrality and cannot pass consensus by multiplying aliases. Whether a peer is called prism, oasis, or zenith, only sustained, corroborated behavior earns weight.
